newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Palladium firm, other metals mixed in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Palladium firm, other metals mixed in Europe.

text.p: Uncertainty about Russian deliveries to Japan continued to support palladium prices in calm early trading in Europe, but traders said they expected narrow ranges to prevail on Wednesday.
"A lot depends on palladium and platinum. They could help the other metals, but I have the feeling it is going to stay quiet," one dealer at a Swiss bank said.
Palladium opened at at $156.00/$157.00 an ounce, up from $153.50/$154.50 at the London close on Tuesday.
Gold started at $347.50/$348.00, down from $348.20/$348.70 but above support around $346.50.
Silver opened little changed at $4.77/$4.79 versus $4.78/$4.80.
